description: Detects the ESC8 relay chain. From one source address, within two minutes, (1) a coercion named pipe is opened over IPC$ on a Domain Controller (5145 on efsrpc, netdfs, FssagentRpc or spoolss, or on lsarpc, lsass, samr or netlogon with the Impacket 0x3 mask; adcs_esc8_coercion_pipe_on_dc_base.yml), and (2) a Domain Controller machine account logs on to the CA host with NTLM over the network (4624 LogonType 3; adcs_ca_host_dc_ntlm_logon_base.yml). Both events carry the relay host's address in IpAddress, which is the group-by. The third step, the CA receiving or issuing a certificate whose Requester is that DC (4886 or 4887; adcs_cert_request_dc_requester_base.yml), carries no address and is left to triage and to the native query. This replaces the v3 rule, which alerted on any 4886 or 4887 whose Requester ended in "$". Domain Controllers enrol for their own certificates with Kerberos, so a DC account arriving at the CA over NTLM from the address that just coerced a DC is the relay shape.
